paper_id: Sifting through the Chaff_ On Utilizing Execution Feedback for Ranking the Generated Code Candidates
title: Sifting through the Chaff: On Utilizing Execution Feedback for Ranking the Generated Code Candidates
motivation: Execution-based ranking受限于单元测试稀缺和安全风险；非执行方法CodeRanker仅用分类标签，无法理解错误根因
problem_framing: Code ranking——从LLM生成的多个候选代码中选择正确代码；核心难题是仅靠分类标签不足以训练出能理解错误原因的ranker
key_insight: 多任务学习整合代码分类与执行反馈生成，使ranker既具备基本分类能力，又能深度理解错误根因，从而在推理时不依赖执行反馈
method_signature: RankEF通过硬/软参数共享和中间微调三策略，用分类损失+生成损失联合训练CodeT5+，推理时不执行代码
evaluation_criteria: Pass@1/2/5 on APPS, MBPP, HumanEval benchmarks
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: CodeRanker将错误类型细化到更细粒度后性能反而下降，表明仅增加类别数不能有效提升模型能力
evidence_for_taste: merely increasing the number of categories does not effectively enhance the model’s capability
execution feedback provides valuable insights into why the code fails
execution-based methods...encounter notable limitations, such as scarcity of quality unit tests and security risks
does not allow CodeRanker to grasp the underlying reasons
highly sensitive to label distribution, leading to weak generalization ability
thinking_moves: 从CodeRanker局限出发：仅用正误标签无法捕获索引越界、未定义变量等微妙错误
区分三类执行结果(正确/执行错误/意图错误)，模板化反馈以消除噪声
通过多任务学习将执行反馈信息蒸馏到ranker参数中，实现推理时不依赖执行
消融实验验证hard parameter sharing优于soft sharing和中间微调
λ=0.9的实验选择表明生成任务权重应远高于分类任务
